title: Holy priest: no shield on an Arms warrior in Defensive Stance when a Protection paladin tank is also in the group (#1553)

rules.desc: Regression guard for #1553: a Holy priest casts no Power Word: Shield on a Defensive-Stance Arms warrior above the critical band in combat, with a Protection paladin hired as a second tank in the group
rules.why_expect: this pinned #1553, and #1553 is fixed (TortoiseBots 5f57e84f2, PR #1557), so the expectation is PASS: the trial now guards the fix. The bug reproduced only with a second tank: with the hired paladin in the party, HasOtherTank (AiFactory.cpp:520-576) returns true for the warrior and GetPlayerRoles (:597-611) returns GetTalentRoles(player) = Arms = DPS instead of reading Defensive Stance as TANK, so the priest shielded a tank read as a DPS above the critical band. PriestActions.h:43-49 now passes TankForShield(target, ..., warrior && HasAura(71), druid && (HasAura 5487 || 9634)) into ShouldShieldTarget (ShieldTargetPolicy.h:23-39): Defensive Stance counts as a tank whatever GetPlayerRoles says. The bench-fix-1111 run showed 0 shields in its one valid rep, so min_reps 3 keeps a single rep from deciding the guard

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the runner re-casts the stance and excludes time without it
